speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Eggs. The sheets are by your trencher. I am not going to read them for you.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Is all our company heere?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Read it as it is written. Six tradesmen, met to cast a play.

speaker: will_kemp
text: The weaver would be the lover, and the lady, and then he will have the lion too.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Read on. Keep your elbow out of the mustard.

speaker: will_kemp
text: let mee play the Lyon to

speaker: will_kemp
text: This is Ercles vaine, a tyrants vaine

speaker: agnes_tipping
text: God's my life, Master Kemp. Dinner's sixpence, wit's extra, and the jug is on the floor.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Put it on the slate. I am only at the second leaf.

speaker: will_kemp
text: He'd play the whole of it himself and be loved for it. That's me. Thou'st put me in, thou villain.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I put in the best of thee, Will.

speaker: will_kemp
text: And after?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: In the third act he's given an ass's head, and a queen falls in love with him.

speaker: will_kemp
text: With the head on?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: She'd not have thee else.

speaker: will_kemp
text: An ass's head? With long ears that wag on a string? Now thou talk'st like a Christian playwright!

speaker: agnes_tipping
text: Over the board and into the rushes. What goes in your mouth is sixpence, and what goes on my floor is charged double.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Chalk it double. I will not ask you the figure.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: You have the queen and the ears, if the pages are true. You may keep them. I am staying on you.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Keep your own lines. I have these three sheets, and I am not asking you for a day.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The three sheets are what there is. The play is not finished. I am not naming a day.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: I have shut the book on the tally.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Shut it. When the rest is a thing, I will read it sitting, as I read this.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: When it is a thing. Not before the eggs are done.

speaker: agnes_tipping
text: Eat, the pair of you, while it is hot.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: You heard him. The book is shut. I am not opening a quarrel over a jug.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The book is shut. These three sheets are the supper I came to give.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Thou villain. I will say it once more, and then I will eat.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Once is the once that mattered. Eat.
